chunks: “The first thing of justice that the Qa'im عليه السلام will manifest is that his caller will announce that those engaged in nafilah must yield the Black Stone and the circumambulation of the House to those engaged in the obligatory duty.”

key_terms.النَّافِلَةِ: supererogatory devotional act beyond what is obligatory
key_terms.الْحَجَرَ الْأَسْوَدَ: the Black Stone at the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْعَدْلِ: justice, fairness in ordering rights and priorities
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory duty that takes legal priority
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: the awaited Qa'im, the one who will rise with divine authority
key_terms.مُنَادِيهِ: his caller or announcer who proclaims his command

ai.seo_question: What is one of the first acts of justice the Qa'im عليه السلام will establish during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that among the earliest manifestations of the Qa'im’s عليه السلام justice will be giving precedence in the rites of hajj to those performing the obligatory duty over those engaged in supererogatory devotion. It highlights ordered fairness in worship and presents this as a sign of his just rule.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3132 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"The first act of justice that the Qa'im (as) will manifest is that his caller will announce: 'Those performing supererogatory acts (nafilah) must yield the Black Stone and the Tawaf around the Kaaba to those performing obligatory acts (faridah).'"
